{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|gr1= Systems

|descr= Makes a High Altitude Low Opening (HALO) parachute jump.
{{Feature|arma3|HALO feature is already implemented in {{arma3}}. Using this function will result in incorrect behaviour and animation.}}

|s1= [unit, altitude] call [[BIS_fnc_halo]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - the HALO-performing unit

|p2= altitude: [[Number]] - (Optional, default 0) altitude added to the unit before HALO

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>[player] call BIS_fnc_halo; // instantly parachutes the player object</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[player, 100] call BIS_fnc_halo; // increases the altitude of player by 100 before HALO</sqf>

|seealso= [[setUnitFreefallHeight]] [[getUnitFreefallInfo]]
}}
